scope: Shared Supabase migration, read-only catalog/data-integrity verification and manual two-session browser exchange acceptance; scope limits recorded separately.

account_roles.teacher: Existing administrator acting as teacher; no administrator write action performed.
account_roles.learner: Dedicated ordinary account created through Supabase Authentication with auto-confirmation; no administrator privileges.

checks.actual: Existing administrator account signed in to the shared backend. Dashboard reloaded with balance 1, earned 7 and spent 9; no loading error.
Own profile and four owned skills persisted after reload. Discovery reloaded with 116 teacher listings and public teacher names.
Existing administrator account passed the server-side administrator gate and loaded dispute records. No dispute action was performed.
Administrator account acting as teacher created a labeled acceptance-test listing through My Skills; listing persisted after reload.
After sign-out, protected /profile visits redirected to /login without profile content; repeated successfully with the ordinary learner after settlement.
Dedicated learner account was redirected from /admin to the ordinary dashboard. Administrator dispute content did not render.

Dedicated account created through Supabase Authentication with email auto-confirmed; real application login succeeded and profile initialized with 3 credits. This does not test public signup or email delivery.

Dedicated learner found the labeled teacher listing and sent one request through the application. Request success message appeared. After dashboard reload, the matching exchange appeared as pending; learner balance remained 3.
Teacher accepted the matching request; accepted state survived reload. Mark as Complete moved the simulated lesson to Waiting on learner; unrelated existing requests were not modified.

Learner clicked Confirm once and received Exchange confirmed. Learner balance changed 3 to 2 and teacher balance changed 1 to 2. After reloading Confirm exchanges, no exchange or confirmation control remained for the settled lesson.

Independent dashboards reloaded with learner balance 2 / spent 1 and teacher balance 2 / earned 8. Teacher spent remained 9 and learner earned remained 0; combined balance remained 4. Read-only Supabase inspection found exactly one matching completed exchange. Reconstructing the pretest balance digest by excluding the new learner and subtracting the single teacher credit matched the pre-upgrade digest.

browser_walkthrough.evidence_retention: Visually verified learner ledger crop included as sanitized repository evidence. Credentials, authentication state and raw screenshots remain ignored local artifacts.
limits: Teacher used an existing administrator account; this is not a two-ordinary-account run.
Learner was created using Supabase Authentication auto-confirmation; public signup and email delivery were not tested.
No real instruction, administrator dispute write, hosted concurrency or hosted private-video HTTP test was performed.
Frontend served locally against shared Supabase; externally hosted frontend deployment was not verified.

screenshots.checkpoint: Ordinary learner ledger after confirmed settlement and dashboard reload; earned 0, spent 1.
